title: Self-play's leakage examples say what a kind's own machine kept out: forecasting and time to event taught that their planted leaks were allowed
request: Fix the false leakage examples of own-machine kinds: forecasting's leakage examples said nothing was forbidden while its machine keeps the planted leak out.
spec: dclab_rnd/lake/selfplay.py (examples_of: leakage_judgment and the solution_design leakage step); the machines' leakage stages in dclab_rnd/kinds/forecasting.py, time_to_event.py, uplift.py, embedded.py.
plan: Count, on the stored examples, which kinds' leakage answers miss a leak or an identifier their replica planted.
Read each machine's leakage stage: what kept_out, declared_leakage_features and why mean there.
Failing test on forecasting and time to event; then add the machine's declared leaks to the answer.
Check the other machine kinds' examples stay the same.

decisions.decision: Add the machine's declared_leakage_features, not its kept_out.
decisions.why: kept_out means different things per machine: the embedded machine lists every column it does not read, which is not a leak; declared_leakage_features is each machine's own list of leaks.

decisions.decision: A kept-out column whose reason says identifier goes to identifiers.
decisions.why: The survival and uplift machines put identifiers into the same kept-out list; calling an identifier a leak would teach another false answer.

decisions.decision: Runs without a machine are unchanged.
decisions.why: Their Solution's forbidden list is the engine's decision, and the count found their examples right.

decisions.decision: The stored examples are not solved again here.
decisions.why: It replaces training data in the lake; the owner decides when, with the command given.

change: dclab_rnd/lake/selfplay.py (kept_out, used by both leakage families of examples_of), tests/test_selfplay_kinds.py

findings.defect: Every forecasting leakage example said forbidden is empty while rain_mm, the day's weather, is a planted leak its machine keeps out.
findings.scenario: lake/bronze/selfplay/examples.jsonl, selfplay:forecasting:0: forbidden [] on a table with rain_mm.
findings.cause: examples_of read the Solution's forbidden list; a machine keeps its leaks in its leakage stage.
findings.fix: kept_out() adds the machine's declared leaks with its reasons.

findings.defect: Every time-to-event leakage example left out tickets_so_far, counted during the follow-up.
findings.scenario: selfplay:time_to_event:0: forbidden months_billed and cancelled, not tickets_so_far.
findings.cause: The same: the survival machine keeps it out, the Solution does not name it.
findings.fix: The same, with an identifier the machine keeps out sent to identifiers.

findings.defect: The lake benchmark's truth reads leak and leaks but not leaky_columns, so multiclass and regression leaks are never scored there.
findings.scenario: benchmark.truth on a multiclass row gives no planted leak while its replica plants resolved_by and first_response_minutes.
findings.cause: Replicas name their leaks under different keys.

findings.defect: A kept-out column was called an identifier when its reason held the word anywhere.
findings.scenario: A moment sentence quoting the word identifier makes a leak's reason match, so the leak is filed as an identifier.
findings.cause: A substring test on the machine's reason text.
findings.fix: Match only the machines' own identifier reasons (IDENTIFIER_REASONS).

measurements.name: false leakage examples in the stored lake
measurements.gate: every leakage example keeps its replica's planted leaks and identifiers out
measurements.result: forecasting 100 of 100 and time_to_event 93 of 93 unmasked examples miss their leak; every other kind none
limits: measured on the unmasked variant; the masked twin carries the same answer
the stored examples stay false until the two kinds are solved again

measurements.name: new solves after the fix
measurements.gate: the planted leaks in forbidden with the machine's reason, identifiers apart, other kinds unchanged
measurements.result: forecasting and time_to_event tests pass; uplift, embedded and embedded_images give the same leakage example as stored; time_to_event gains only tickets_so_far
limits: checked on one seed per kind

measurements.name: affected tests
limits: the full gate was not run: the owner's daytime rule is one test, and check-quick ran earlier the same day

outcome: New self-play solves teach that a machine kind's planted leak stays out; the stored forecasting and time-to-event examples still need solving again.
lessons: Before turning a run into an answer, read where that kind records the decision: a machine keeps it in its own stage, not in the Solution.
Measure training data against the planted truth before trusting it: a count over the stored lake found two kinds false on every row.
risks: A machine that words an identifier in a new way would see it called a leak until IDENTIFIER_REASONS names it.
